agent.report:
No changes were made, and the working tree was already clean, so there was nothing to commit.

```yaml
rules:   # each rule of the application the change touches, in a few words, with the name the code gives it when it has one
  - Review window: a traveller's or host's review is written from the day after check-out up to 14 days after it (REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS, isInReviewWindow; refusal OutsideReviewWindow)
  - Publication at window close: a stay's two reviews are published together, when both are written or the window has closed (isPublished, windowClosed; ADR 60)
  - Host reply only once published (replyToTravellerReview; refusal ReviewNotPublished)
  - Report of a published review; an unpublished review is a not-found to anyone but its author (reportReview; ADR 63)
  - Ratings count only published traveller reviews, per listing and per host (publishedTravellerReviews, ratingsOfListings, ratingOf; ADR 61), read through Booking's and Listings' RatingsOfListings and GetHostRating
  - Review read visibility (publishedOn; GetListingReviews, GetGuestReviews, GetBookingReviews)
files:   # each source file (tests excluded) the change would modify, by its path from the repository's root
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/ReviewWindow.ts          # REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS = 14; every rule above reads the window from here
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewExceptions.ts  # OutsideReviewWindow message text says "14 days"
tests:   # each test file that would fail if only the source were changed, or that the change would modify, by its path
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviews.spec.ts      # refusals at day 25 (lines ~87, ~153), window edges (~176-187), reply at day 25 (~230)
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewReports.spec.ts  # report of a lone review at day 25 (~121)
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/Rating.spec.ts           # AFTER_WINDOW = 2026-05-16 expects publication (~90)
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/reviews.e2e.spec.ts                       # publication asserted on day +20 (~139, ~303)
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/ratings.e2e.spec.ts                       # ratings published on day +22 (~169)
# Unclear, decided here: the claim window (CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS in src/Contexts/Support/Domain/Claim/ClaimRules.ts) is a separate rule that
# ADR 74 says shares the review window's 14 days. I left it out because it is not the review window; if the team wants claims to follow,
# add that file and its tests (claims e2e and claim unit specs).
# Not listed, because they are not source: the glossary in conventions/domain.yaml (lines ~294, ~302), conventions/storms/reviews.yaml, and
# ADRs 59, 60, 62, 74 all state 14 days. conventions and docs/adr are protected in feature mode, so updating them is an architecture decision.
# Behaviour consequence (not a file change): publication is computed on read, so nothing is stored. Lone reviews that show today on days
# 15 to 30 after check-out would disappear from listings and ratings until the window closes at day 30.
```
